title: Compare recall with accuracy guard against F1 using frozen labels and matched partitions after web workspace verification

comments.author: home
comments.text: Inspected actual API-owned data before launching the objective comparison. The legacy three-classifier run fe9e2b07-523a-42c4-af18-2fc0f5543ad0 has 85 fully labeled items; Anthus definition revision 1 matches its classifier revisions. The four-classifier backfill has zero completed items. Fixed a setup defect where saved classifier policies silently overrode an explicit run objective: explicit run policies now apply to effective classifier policies without editing definitions. New specs prove recall/accuracy versus F1 replay configs differ while frozen items, labels, comments, source history, and protection protocol match. Recorded the complete pilot plan in docs/objective-comparison-plan.md before paid collection. Current protected set has 16 items; positive counts across the three classifiers are 1/2/0. Development positive counts are 2/0/1, so two classifiers cannot clear the current coverage floor. Planned run must be labeled diagnostic and cannot establish an all-classifier winner or invent missing recall. No live replay launched yet; original labels and active scorecard unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Objective setup and frozen endpoint safeguards verified: all 737 Python specs pass. Explicit objective overrides preserve saved definitions; two replay configs keep identical frozen labels/comments/items and differ in effective policies. Frozen head/provider/joint-context mismatch is rejected for both endpoints before either makes calls. The preregistered diagnostic pilot uses Anthus definition 1, fixed arxiv-web-v1 seed and cadences, and ceilings of 1000 decision attempts/100 optimizer calls per replay. Plan remains docs/objective-comparison-plan.md. No pilot has executed yet; coverage limitations remain disclosed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live diagnostic comparison is now running through the GraphQL API on the deployed backend. Recall plus accuracy guard run: 25804ab2-b027-4853-bfa2-e1a8e50dbd94. F1 run: 764466bd-dda5-4820-be3d-625e1d22d3fc. Both freeze the same 85 source items, human labels and explanations under Anthus definition revision 1; ceilings remain 1000 decision attempts and 100 optimizer calls per run. Sequential orchestrator uses stable objective-pilot-cycle command IDs and stops on failed/interrupted jobs without automatic paid retry. Verified live progress: first replay completed 30 cycles without reported warnings and queued cycle 33. Original interactive labeling history remains unchanged. Neither replay nor the protected endpoint comparison is complete; no winner claimed.
